seo.title: About Matchy+ | Local services and professionals
seo.description: Discover Matchy+, the platform that connects individuals and businesses with local professionals based on their needs and location.
seo.openGraphTitle: About Matchy+ | Connecting local needs with talent
seo.openGraphDescription: Discover the Matchy+ mission: make local services easier to access and create more opportunities for professionals.

hero.title: Connecting local needs with the right skills
hero.text: Matchy+ helps individuals and businesses discover professionals nearby while giving local talent greater visibility and access to new opportunities.

sections.title: Our mission
sections.text: Make it easier to find a professional and help every local skill become more visible. Matchy+ brings individuals, businesses, artisans, freelancers and service providers together through an accessible, location-based experience designed around local needs.

sections.title: Why Matchy+ exists
sections.text: Finding someone who is available and suited to a specific need can take time. At the same time, many professionals have valuable skills but limited visibility and access to new customers. Matchy+ brings both sides together on one platform.

sections.title: What Matchy+ enables
sections.text: For users: search for a service, discover profiles based on need and location, and connect directly. For professionals: showcase skills, define a service area, improve visibility and access new opportunities.

sections.title: More relevant connections
sections.text: Location and personalized recommendations help surface profiles that may match a stated need. Recommendations make discovery easier, but every user remains free to review, compare and choose.

sections.title: Useful everyday services
sections.text: Matchy+ can support searches for professionals in plumbing, electrical work, transport, cleaning, childcare, gardening, home repairs and other local services. Availability varies depending on registered profiles and service areas.

sections.title: A platform designed for professionals
sections.text: Professionals can showcase their activity through a clear profile, services, experience, location and contact preferences. Matchy Explore supports profile discovery, while Matchy Wallet may provide additional visibility options depending on active offers.

sections.title: Our vision
sections.text: Build a useful, accessible pan-African platform grounded in local realities. Matchy+ aims to make skills more visible, services more accessible and economic opportunities closer to communities.

sections.title: Trust and responsibility
sections.text: Matchy+ supports discovery and initial contact. Before any service, users should check relevant information, clarify the need and agree on the price, timeframe and conditions. The presence of a profile does not automatically validate every declared skill.

items.title: Proximity
items.text: Highlight needs, talent and opportunities around each user.

items.title: Accessibility
items.text: Provide a simple, understandable experience for different user profiles.

items.title: Usefulness
items.text: Build features that address practical everyday needs.

items.title: Opportunity
items.text: Help professionals make their skills visible and grow their activity.

items.question: What is Matchy+?
items.answer: Matchy+ is a platform that connects individuals and businesses with local professionals based on the requested service and location.

items.question: Who is Matchy+ for?
items.answer: Matchy+ is for people looking for services, professionals offering their skills and businesses searching for service providers.

items.question: How does Matchy+ help professionals?
items.answer: Professionals can create a profile, showcase services, specify their service area and access visibility tools depending on available features.

items.question: Where is Matchy+ available?
items.answer: Availability depends on registered professionals and their service areas. The platform aims to expand progressively in Tunisia and other African markets.

finalCta.title: Join Matchy+
finalCta.text: Whether you are looking for a professional or growing your activity, Matchy+ helps create simpler, faster and more relevant local connections.
